readme_excerpt: Node.js Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment. For information on using Node.js, see the [Node.js website][]. The Node.js project uses an open governance model. The [OpenJS Foundation][] provides support for the project. Contributors are expected to act in a collaborative manner to move the project forward.
